rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable dangerous-zone/braking-zone definition where the baseline ORR3 and CRD3 relied on the previously unspecified dangerous-zone boundary and the need to revalidate if the distance or spatial-information requirement or the dangerous-zone definition changes. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged, so the impact is limited to the ORR preserving braking-relevant distance classification.
